articles.title: SJAA Ephemeris Bulletin
articles.summary: The SJAA Ephemeris Bulletin for October 2025 highlights the value of its community, announcing a new Discord server to enhance member connection. It features the Double Cluster as the "Target of the Month," providing observational details and historical context. Additionally, the bulletin announces a 'Member Show and Tell' event, details a new membership renewal system, and encourages members to volunteer.
